verdict.rationale: Wrike is a work-management SaaS platform, not a coding agent or development environment, so having a coding agent auto-detect and install toolchains and dependencies is a category error for this product. Its documented agents handle work-management tasks such as triage and risk assessment, not provisioning build environments, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
